thread:
alex: Heads up — a small backfill job hit heavy deadletters after yesterday's telemetry schema tweak. Seeing ~18% failure rate for rows with missing `device.os_version`. Can we triage routing/quotas before we re-run? :thinking:
Sana: Ugh. Is that the change where the producer started sending `os_version: null` instead of omitting the field?
Dylan: Yup. The reprocess job treats null as invalid for the aggregate join. We can either patch the consumer mapping or make the recompute tolerant (coerce null->'unknown') during backfill.
alex: Short-term I want to avoid re-running full EU aggregates until we have a plan. Suggest we run a targeted dry-run on a couple of shards and add a dedupe/idempotency key to avoid double-counting.
Maya: Agreed. Also we should not exhaust the backfill quota. Can we run the dry-run under the low-priority lane with a strict token quota and a console toggle so PMs can preview regressions?
Kevin: Console flag sounds good. We have the preflight checkbox UI but not a dedicated "backfill-dry-run" mode that toggles routing to priority=low + sample=0.01. I can add a flag in the console (UX: small inline text explaining sample size).
Dylan: For routing, we need to ensure the replay broker routes these requests to separate worker pool (no KV cache pollution). Add `replay_tag:dryrun` header and route via existing policy table to dedicated backfill pool.
alex: Can you also ensure telemetry emits a metric `replay.deadletters.rate` with tag `dryrun:true/false` so we can compare before/after? We should not mix dryrun telemetry with production aggregates.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Replay service patch deployed to canary (rev 2024.11.3).
Sana: For idempotency, what's the simplest dedupe key? `tenant_id + event_id`? If the event_id was regenerated upstream we'll still have issues.
Dylan: Use `tenant_id + original_event_hash` (hash of raw payload) — we already compute that during ingest, and the backfill can attach it. Low overhead and stable.
Maya: Okay plan: (1) Add console dry-run flag (Kevin), (2) Deploy routing header support + route rule to dryrun pool (Dylan), (3) Add null -> 'unknown' coercion as an option for the backfill transform (Sana), (4) Emit dryrun metric tag (alex), (5) Run targeted dry-run on 3 shards at 2am UTC with sample=1% and review telemetry. Who owns coordination?
alex: I'll own coordination and will file the high-level ticket. Kevin + Dylan + Sana — please mark tasks in the ticket and post PR links here.
Kevin: I'll put a small console change up and link the mock. PR soon: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/1234 :thumbsup:
Dylan: Routing PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/replay/pulls/987 (adds `replay_tag` and dryrun pool rule).
Sana: Transform patch: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest/pulls/444 (adds coercion config + feature flag).
Maya: I'll schedule the dry-run window and set the replay token quota to 5k reqs/hour for the job. Also will add a dashboard tile for `replay.deadletters.rate{dryrun:true}` and a comparison panel.
alex: If metrics look good after dry-run (deadletters << 1%), we can plan a staged recompute with increasing sample & priority. If not, roll back and fix consumer mapping.
Sana: One small note — some legacy aggregates assume non-null os_version for bucketing. The coerced 'unknown' might shift counts. We'll include a regression eval set (10 canonical queries) in the console preflight.
Dylan: Good call. Add a console modal that runs the 10 eval prompts against dry-run outputs. Kevin can wire that into the dry-run flag UX.
alex: Great. Expect follow-ups in the ticket. Thanks all. :pray:
